headline: Business Liquidity Problems Are Intensifying. Amounts Refused for Payment by Banks on Promissory Notes, Cheques and Bills of Exchange Reached Over 4.6 Billion Lei in the First 8 Months of 2026, the Highest in the Last Decade. Payment Refusals Are an Indicator Reflecting the State of the Economy
summary: Banks refused payment of cheques, promissory notes and bills of exchange worth over 4.6 billion lei in the first eight months of 2026. The amount is more than double the same period last year.
why: Payment refusals on commercial paper signal stress in business liquidity and credit conditions. Romania's economy depends on small and mid-sized firms that rely on such instruments.

original_headline: Se intensifică tot mai mult problemele cu lichiditatea în mediul de business. Sumele refuzate la plată de bănci cu bilete la ordin, cecuri  şi cambii au ajuns în 8 luni/2026 la peste 4,6 mld. lei, maximul ultimului deceniu. Refuzurile la plată sunt un indicator care reflectă situaţia economiei
